newsitem.title: USA: ADM begins $80 mln lysine plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: ADM begins $80 mln lysine plant expansion.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co said Wednesday it has begun an $80 million expansion of its Decatur, Illinois, lysine plant.
Once the expansion is completed, the facility, ADM's only lysine plant, will have a total annual capacity of 350 million pounds, the company said.
"This expansion is in response to the rapidly growing worldwide market for high quality feed additives," ADM said in a release.
Further information on the company's current lysine production capacity was not immediately available.
